jobDescription: Our plant fills and packs household cleaning products on eleven lines. The Controls Software Engineer writes and maintains the PLC and HMI software for the packaging lines, manages version control of the controller programs, supports line commissioning after equipment changes and works with the IT security team on segmenting the plant network. The role holds remote-access rights to the control network, so group policy requires engineers in it to be 62443 certified, specifically the ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist certificate, before access is granted.
requirements: Writes and maintains PLC programs (IEC 61131-3) and HMI screens for packaging lines.
Holds the ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist certificate.
Keeps controller programs under version control with a documented change history.
Supports commissioning of line changes, including I/O checks and handover to operations.
Works with IT security on the zoning and conduit design of the plant network.

evidence.text: Controls Engineer, Wexcombe Personal Care (January 2022 to August 2026): wrote structured-text and ladder logic for case packers and labellers on ControlLogix controllers and redesigned the HMI alarm pages for three lines.
Moved 140 controller programs from a shared drive into a version-control tool for automation projects, with a check-in comment and a named reviewer for every change.
ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist: training courses IC32 and IC33 completed in June 2026; certificate exam booked for 18 November 2026.
Ran the I/O checks and wrote the operator handover sheet when a second labeller was added to line 4, and stayed on site for the first two shifts after restart.
Took part in workshops with the IT security team that divided the plant network into cell zones and documented the conduits between them and the site office network.

Work sample: a change record for the line 4 labeller program, showing the program diff, the reviewer's comments, the I/O checklist completed during commissioning and the shift supervisor's acceptance signature.
HR verification note: employment dates and the title Controls Engineer at Wexcombe Personal Care were checked against the employment letter supplied by Wexcombe's HR department and match the resume.

Reference check summary: the former engineering manager at Wexcombe confirmed in writing that the candidate moved the controller programs into version control and commissioned the second labeller on line 4.

propositions.text: The candidate moved 140 controller programs into a version-control tool, with a check-in comment and a named reviewer for every change.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the migration and the former engineering manager confirmed it in writing.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the I/O checks and the operator handover when a second labeller was added to line 4.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the commissioning, the work sample contains the change record and I/O checklist, and the reference confirms the work.

propositions.text: The candidate holds the ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Fundamentals Specialist certificate.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry itself shows that the training courses are complete and the certificate exam is booked for 18 November 2026; a booked exam is not a held certificate, and the qualification rule forbids upgrading a certification beyond explicit cited evidence.

gold.expectedGap: The ISA/IEC 62443 certificate is not yet held: the courses are complete and the exam is booked for 18 November 2026.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Report the completed courses and the booked exam as they stand and keep the documented PLC, version-control, commissioning and network-zoning work; do not describe the candidate as 62443 certified.
followUpTargets: Ask for the outcome of the 18 November 2026 exam and the certificate number once issued.
